models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description:
Registered customer accounts with email and password credentials for shopping operations. This table serves as the primary identity record for customers who can browse products, add items to cart, place orders, write reviews, and manage their profiles and addresses. Customer accounts support soft deletion to preserve order history and reviews while removing personal credentials.

Related entities: {@link shopping_mall_customer_sessions} for authentication sessions, {@link shopping_mall_customer_password_resets} for account recovery, {@link shopping_mall_customer_email_verifications} for email confirmation, {@link shopping_mall_orders} for purchase history, {@link shopping_mall_reviews} for product feedback.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Customer's email address used for authentication and communication. Must be unique across all customer accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hashed password for customer authentication. Never stores plain text passwords.

plainFields.name: nickname
plainFields.description: Customer's display name shown in reviews and public-facing content. Can be updated by the customer.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Customer's contact phone number for order notifications and delivery coordination.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created. Used for auditing and account age verification.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was last updated. Tracks profile modifications and credential changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was soft deleted. Null for active accounts. Preserves order history and reviews while removing authentication credentials.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for customer authentication with access and refresh token support. Tracks customer login sessions with connection metadata including IP address, initial page URL, and referrer. Sessions are append-only audit records that expire based on security policies.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address at session creation for security auditing.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Initial page URL where the session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from which the session originated.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp for security. Sessions are invalid after this time.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for customer account recovery. Each record represents a password reset request with a unique token that expires after a specified time period. Tokens are single-use and marked as consumed when successfully used for password reset. Multiple reset requests can exist per customer, with only the most recent unexpired token being valid.

This is a subsidiary table managed through the parent customer entity, not independently accessed by users.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who requested the password reset. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token sent to customer's email. Used to verify identity during password reset process.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reset token becomes invalid. Tokens typically expire after 1-24 hours for security.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset record was last updated.

plainFields.name: consumed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this token was successfully used to reset password. Null if token has not been used or has expired.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for customer registration confirmation. Stores verification codes sent to customer email addresses during registration or email change requests. Each token has an expiration time and tracks whether it has been successfully verified. Tokens are consumed after verification or expiration.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Verification token code sent to customer email.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Token becomes invalid after this time.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when token was successfully verified. Null if not yet verified or expired.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description: Registered seller accounts with email/password credentials for product management and order processing. Sellers require administrator approval before they can list products and manage inventory. This table serves as the canonical identity record for the seller actor type, with authentication credentials and shop profile attributes. Sessions are tracked in {@link shopping_mall_seller_sessions}, password resets in {@link shopping_mall_seller_password_resets}, and email verifications in {@link shopping_mall_seller_email_verifications}.

foreignFields.name: approved_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who approved or rejected this seller account. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for seller authentication and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hashed password for seller authentication.

plainFields.name: shop_name
plainFields.description: Display name of the seller's shop or store.

plainFields.name: shop_description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the shop's products, brand, and business.

plainFields.name: logo_image_url
plainFields.description: URL to the shop's logo or brand image.

plainFields.name: approval_status
plainFields.description: Admin approval status: PENDING (awaiting review), APPROVED (can list products), REJECTED (application denied).

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided by administrator if approval was rejected.

plainFields.name: suspended
plainFields.description: Whether the seller account is temporarily suspended. Suspended sellers cannot create or edit products but can process existing orders.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was soft deleted. Null if account is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for seller authentication with access and refresh token support.

This table tracks all login sessions for seller accounts, storing connection metadata and temporal information for security auditing. Each session represents an authenticated connection with token-based access control.

Sessions are created during seller login and track the connection context including IP address, request URL, and referrer. The expired_at field enforces session lifetime limits for security. Sessions form an append-only audit trail of seller authentication events.

Related to {@link shopping_mall_sellers} through many-to-one relationship (one seller can have multiple active sessions).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client connection for security auditing and session tracking.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL of the login request for connection context tracking.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header indicating the page that initiated the login request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created (login time).

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires and becomes invalid for security enforcement.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for seller account recovery. Each record represents a password reset request with a unique token and expiration timestamp. Tokens are single-use and become invalid after expiration or when used. This table supports the password recovery flow by allowing sellers to request password resets via email with time-limited tokens.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller account requesting password reset. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token sent to seller's email. Used to verify reset request authenticity.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token expires and becomes invalid. Typically 1-24 hours from creation.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was successfully used to reset password. Null if not yet used or expired.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens for seller registration confirmation.

Stores verification tokens sent to seller email addresses during registration. Each token has an expiration time and tracks when (if) the email was verified. Multiple verification attempts can exist per seller (e.g., if token expires and user requests resend).

Related to {@link shopping_mall_sellers} through seller_id foreign key. Managed automatically through authentication flows, not direct user operations.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller account this verification token belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token sent via email to the seller. Used to confirm email ownership during registration.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification token expires. Tokens are invalid after this time.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the email was successfully verified using this token. Null if not yet verified or expired.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification record was soft deleted. Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_admins
models.description:
Administrator accounts with elevated privileges for platform management and seller approval.

Represents authenticated administrators who can manage categories, approve seller registrations, view all products and orders, ban users, and oversee platform operations. The grade field distinguishes between regular administrators (ADMIN) and super administrators (SUPER_ADMIN) who have additional privileges to manage other administrators.

This table serves as the primary identity record for administrators with its own authentication flow. Sessions are stored in {@link shopping_mall_admin_sessions} and password reset tokens in {@link shopping_mall_admin_password_resets}. Admin promotion requests are tracked in {@link shopping_mall_admin_requests} and reviewed by super administrators.

Categories are created by administrators via the created_by_admin_id foreign key reference.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Administrator's email address used for authentication and login. Must be unique across all administrator accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt-hashed password for secure authentication. Never stored in plain text.

plainFields.name: grade
plainFields.description: Administrator privilege level. ADMIN: Can manage categories, approve sellers, view products/orders, ban users. SUPER_ADMIN: Can also manage other administrators (promote/demote) and approve admin requests.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was soft-deleted (deactivated). Null means the account is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_sessions
models.description:
Login session tracking for administrator authentication. Each record represents one authenticated admin session with connection metadata including IP address, request URL, and referrer. Sessions have expiration timestamps for security and are used to validate admin access tokens during platform management operations.

This table is a child of shopping_mall_admins with a many-to-one relationship (one admin can have multiple concurrent sessions). Sessions are created on successful login and validated on each authenticated request. Expired sessions require re-authentication.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who owns this session. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the admin logged in. Used for security auditing and session validation.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL (href) of the page where the login was initiated. Captures the entry point for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header value indicating the previous page. Used for tracking navigation flow and security analysis.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created (login time).

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session expires. Sessions are invalid after this time and require re-authentication.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for administrator account recovery. Each token is generated when an administrator requests a password reset and expires after a defined period. Tokens are single-use and invalidated after successful password change or expiration.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator account requesting password reset. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: token_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password reset token for secure verification. Token is sent to administrator's email and must match to complete password reset.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Reset requests must be completed before this time or the token becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was created.

plainIndexes.description: Composite index for efficient lookup of admin's reset tokens and cleanup of expired tokens.

models.name: shopping_mall_super_admins
models.description: Super administrator accounts with the highest privilege level for platform oversight and administrator management. Super admins can promote/demote administrators, approve admin promotion requests, and have full access to all platform operations. This table stores authentication credentials and account state for super administrator users.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address for authentication, unique across all super administrator accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hashed password for secure authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the super administrator account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the super administrator account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the super administrator account was soft deleted, null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_super_admin_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for super administrator authentication with access and refresh token support. Tracks login sessions for super administrators including connection metadata (IP address, request URL, referrer) and session lifecycle timestamps. Each session is tied to exactly one super administrator and is used for authentication and audit trail purposes.

foreignFields.name: super_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Super administrator who owns this session. {@link shopping_mall_super_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client that initiated this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL (href) of the page where the login was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header indicating the page that linked to the login page.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created (login time).

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session expires and becomes invalid.

models.name: shopping_mall_super_admin_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for super administrator account recovery. Each token is generated when a super admin requests password reset, has an expiration time for security, and is marked as used after successful password change. Tokens are single-use and expire automatically.

foreignFields.name: super_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged super administrator's {@link shopping_mall_super_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token sent to the super administrator's email.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Token becomes invalid after this time for security.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was used to reset password. Null if not yet used.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was soft deleted. Null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_categories
models.description: Product classification categories with one-level nesting hierarchy for organizing products in the catalog. Categories are created and managed by administrators, supporting parent-child relationships where each category can have at most one parent level. Products reference categories for classification and filtering.

foreignFields.name: parent_category_id
foreignFields.description: Parent category's {@link shopping_mall_categories.id} for hierarchical nesting. Null for root-level categories.

foreignFields.name: created_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator's {@link shopping_mall_admins.id} who created this category.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Category name for display and identification.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Category description explaining the product classification scope.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was soft-deleted. Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description: Main product listings in the shopping mall catalog. Each product represents an item for sale with a name, description, and base price. Products are owned by sellers and classified into categories. This table maintains active product state, while historical states are preserved in {@link shopping_mall_product_snapshots} for order integrity. Soft delete (deleted flag) hides products from search while preserving them for existing order references.

foreignFields.name: shopping_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Owner seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}. Products belong to exactly one seller who manages the listing.

foreignFields.name: shopping_category_id
foreignFields.description: Assigned category's {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}. Products are classified into exactly one category for organization and browsing.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name displayed in listings and search results. Should be descriptive and unique within seller's catalog.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed product description explaining features, specifications, and usage information. Supports rich text formatting.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base price of the product in the platform's currency. Individual variant prices may override this value. Must be positive.

plainFields.name: deleted
plainFields.description: Soft delete flag. When true, product is hidden from search and browsing but preserved for historical order references. Defaults to false.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was first created. Immutable after initial insertion.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was last modified. Updated on every edit operation.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was soft deleted. Null if product is active. Used for audit trail and potential recovery.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_images
models.description: Product images providing visual representation for product listings. Each product can have multiple images arranged in a specific display order. Images are managed through their parent product and support soft deletion for removal while preserving historical data.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product's {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: URL of the product image stored in cloud storage or CDN.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Display order of the image within the product's image gallery. Lower numbers appear first.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product image was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product image was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product image was soft deleted. Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variants
models.description: Product variants representing different configurations (SKU) of a product. Each variant has a unique SKU code, optional price override, and stock quantity. Variant option values (e.g., color, size) are stored in the child table shopping_mall_product_variant_options to maintain 1NF compliance. Variants are managed by sellers through their products and are referenced by cart items, order items, and inventory records. Soft delete support allows variants to be hidden while preserving historical order data.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product's {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Unique stock keeping unit code identifying this specific variant configuration.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Optional price override for this variant. If null, the product's base price is used.

plainFields.name: stock_quantity
plainFields.description: Current available stock quantity for this variant.

plainFields.name: deleted
plainFields.description: Whether this variant has been soft deleted and should be hidden from catalog.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant was soft deleted. Null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshots
models.description: Immutable point-in-time captures of product state referenced by order items for historical accuracy. Each snapshot preserves the product's name, description, category, and base price at the moment of creation, ensuring order history remains accurate even if the original product is modified or deleted. Snapshots are created when products are edited and are never modified or deleted. Contains multiple {@link shopping_mall_product_snapshot_images} and referenced by {@link shopping_mall_order_items}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Parent product's {@link shopping_mall_products.id} that this snapshot captures.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Category's {@link shopping_mall_categories.id} at the time of snapshot creation.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id} who created this snapshot.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name captured at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Product description captured at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Product base price captured at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: snapshot_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was created, capturing the product state at this moment.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshot_images
models.description: Images captured within product snapshots, preserving the historical visual state of products at the time of snapshot creation. These images are referenced by order items to maintain accurate product representation in historical purchase records. Each snapshot can have multiple images with display order for proper presentation sequence.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Parent product snapshot's {@link shopping_mall_product_snapshots.id}.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: URL location of the product image in the snapshot.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Display sequence order of the image within the snapshot, starting from 0.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot image was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots
models.description: Immutable point-in-time captures of product variant state including SKU code, option values, price, and stock quantity. Each snapshot preserves the exact variant configuration at the time of product snapshot creation, ensuring historical accuracy for order items. Referenced by {@link shopping_mall_order_items} to maintain complete purchase history even when original variants are modified or deleted. Snapshots are append-only and never updated or deleted after creation.

foreignFields.name: product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Source product variant's {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id} that was snapshotted.

foreignFields.name: product_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Parent product snapshot's {@link shopping_mall_product_snapshots.id} that contains this variant snapshot.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) code of the variant at the time of snapshot capture.

plainFields.name: option_values
plainFields.description: JSON string representing the variant's option configuration (e.g., color, size) at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Price override for this variant at snapshot time. Null indicates using the product's base price.

plainFields.name: stock_quantity
plainFields.description: Available stock quantity of the variant at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: snapshot_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant snapshot was created, capturing the point-in-time state.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_options
models.description:
Normalized child table storing product variant option key-value pairs to maintain First Normal Form (1NF) compliance. Each row represents a single option attribute (e.g., color=Red, size=Large) for a product variant. This design enables efficient querying and indexing of individual option values without parsing JSON.

Belongs to {@link shopping_mall_product_variants} and is managed through the parent variant's lifecycle. Multiple options can exist for a single variant, but each option key must be unique per variant to prevent conflicting definitions.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product variant's {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Option attribute name such as color, size, material, or other variant distinguishing characteristics.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Option attribute value such as Red, Large, Cotton, or the specific value for the option key.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this option record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this option record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_records
models.description: Immutable audit trail of stock movements for product variants. Each record captures a single stock movement event with quantity change (positive for increases like restocks or cancellations, negative for decreases like orders or losses), reason code indicating the business event that triggered the movement, and timestamp. Current stock quantity for any variant is calculated by summing all quantity_change values. Records are never modified or deleted to maintain complete audit history for inventory reconciliation and compliance.

foreignFields.name: product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant's {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id} that this inventory movement affects.

plainFields.name: quantity_change
plainFields.description: Amount of stock change. Positive values indicate stock increases (restock, order cancellation, refund approval). Negative values indicate stock decreases (order placement, adjustment, loss, damage).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason code for the inventory movement. Valid values: RESTOCK (manual inventory addition), ORDER (stock reserved for order), ADJUSTMENT (manual correction), CANCELLATION (order cancelled, stock returned), REFUND (refund approved, stock returned), LOSS (damaged/lost items).

plainFields.name: reference_id
plainFields.description: Optional reference to the business entity that triggered this movement (e.g., order_item_id, cancellation_request_id, refund_request_id). Null for manual restocks and adjustments.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the inventory record was created, representing when the stock movement occurred.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlists
models.description: Junction table linking customers to products they want to save for later. Each entry represents one product in a customer's wishlist with the timestamp when it was added. The unique constraint on customer_id and product_id prevents duplicate entries, ensuring each product appears only once per customer's wishlist.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: product_id
foreignFields.description: Wished product's {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was added to the wishlist.

models.name: shopping_mall_carts
models.description: Shopping cart containers representing a customer's active shopping session. Each customer profile owns exactly one cart that accumulates items intended for purchase. Tracks cart creation and last activity timestamps for session management and cart abandonment detection. The cart serves as the container for cart items, which are stored in the shopping_mall_cart_items table.

foreignFields.name: shopping_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}. Each customer has exactly one active cart.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Cart creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp, updated when cart items change or cart is modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for cart archival. Null indicates active cart.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_items
models.description: Individual line items within shopping carts, each representing a specific product variant with quantity and availability status. Cart items are created when customers add products to their cart and are removed during checkout or when explicitly deleted. Each cart can have multiple items, but only one item per variant (quantities are combined rather than creating duplicate lines).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged cart's {@link shopping_mall_carts.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced product variant's {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity of the product variant to purchase. Combined when same variant is added multiple times.

plainFields.name: available
plainFields.description: Whether the product variant is currently available for purchase. Updated based on stock status.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart item was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart item was last modified (quantity change or availability update).

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description:
Customer purchase transactions capturing complete order state at the time of purchase.

Orders represent the core commerce transaction entity, recording when a customer completes a purchase. Each order has a unique order number for reference, total price calculation, and a snapshot of the shipping address to preserve delivery information even if the customer's address changes later.

Orders belong to {@link shopping_mall_customers} and contain multiple {@link shopping_mall_order_items}. Order status is derived from the status of its order items rather than stored directly. Orders reference product snapshots, variant snapshots, and seller profile snapshots through their order items to maintain historical accuracy.

Soft delete support via deleted_at allows order hiding while preserving transaction history for audit and customer records.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who placed this order. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: order_number
plainFields.description: Unique order number for customer reference and support lookup. Generated sequentially or with timestamp prefix.

plainFields.name: total_price
plainFields.description: Total order amount including all items, taxes, and shipping fees. Captured at order time.

plainFields.name: shipping_address_snapshot
plainFields.description: JSON snapshot of shipping address at order time containing recipient_name, phone_number, street_address, city, state_province, postal_code, country. Preserves delivery address even if customer updates their profile.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was placed.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was soft deleted (null if active).

models.name: shopping_mall_order_items
models.description:
Individual line items within customer orders representing purchased product variants.

Each order item captures a specific product variant purchase with quantity and unit price. The item maintains dual references: current entities (product variant, seller) for operational purposes and historical snapshots (product snapshot, product variant snapshot) for order history integrity. This ensures order records remain accurate even if products or variants change after purchase.

Order items follow a status workflow (PAID → SHIPPED → DELIVERED → CANCELLED/REFUNDED) and serve as the foundation for downstream operations including shipment assignment, cancellation requests, refund requests, and review creation. Each item belongs to exactly one order and references one product variant from one seller.

Related entities:
- {@link shopping_mall_orders}: Parent order containing this item
- {@link shopping_mall_product_variants}: Current product variant reference
- {@link shopping_mall_product_snapshots}: Historical product state at order time
- {@link shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots}: Historical variant state at order time
- {@link shopping_mall_sellers}: Current seller reference
- {@link shopping_mall_shipment_items}: Shipment assignments for this item
- {@link shopping_mall_cancellation_requests}: Cancellation requests for this item
- {@link shopping_mall_refund_requests}: Refund requests for this item
- {@link shopping_mall_reviews}: Customer reviews linked to this item

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Parent order's {@link shopping_mall_orders.id} containing this line item.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Current product variant's {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id} for operational reference.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Product snapshot's {@link shopping_mall_product_snapshots.id} capturing historical product state at order time.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant snapshot's {@link shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots.id} capturing historical variant state at order time.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id} who listed this product variant.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Price per unit at order time, preserved for historical accuracy.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current fulfillment status: PAID (payment confirmed), SHIPPED (sent to customer), DELIVERED (received by customer), CANCELLED (order cancelled before shipment), or REFUNDED (refund processed after delivery).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order item was soft-deleted, null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipments
models.description:
Shipments created by sellers to track order item deliveries with carrier information and delivery lifecycle timestamps.

Represents the physical shipment of order items from a seller to a customer. Each shipment contains tracking information including carrier name and tracking number, along with timestamps marking key delivery milestones: when the shipment was sent (shipped_at), when it was delivered (delivered_at), when the customer confirmed receipt (delivery_confirmed_at), and the automatic delivery confirmation timestamp (auto_delivered_at).

Shipments are created by sellers after order items are paid and ready to ship. Multiple shipments can exist for a single order when items come from different sellers. The {@link shopping_mall_shipment_items} table links individual order items to their corresponding shipments.

Delivery lifecycle:
- shipped_at: When seller hands package to carrier
- delivered_at: When carrier marks package as delivered
- delivery_confirmed_at: When customer manually confirms receipt
- auto_delivered_at: System-calculated auto-confirmation (shipped_at + 14 days)

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged order's {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: tracking_carrier
plainFields.description: Name of the shipping carrier (e.g., FedEx, UPS, DHL, USPS). Null until shipment is created.

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Tracking number provided by the carrier for package tracking. Null until shipment is created.

plainFields.name: shipped_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller handed the package to the carrier. Null until actually shipped.

plainFields.name: delivered_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the carrier marked the package as delivered. Null until delivery occurs.

plainFields.name: delivery_confirmed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer manually confirmed receipt of the shipment. Null if not confirmed.

plainFields.name: auto_delivered_at
plainFields.description: System-calculated timestamp for automatic delivery confirmation (shipped_at + 14 days). Used when customer doesn't manually confirm.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment was soft deleted. Null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipment_items
models.description: Junction table linking shipments to order items, enabling one shipment to contain multiple order items from the same seller. Each order item belongs to exactly one shipment, tracked through the unique constraint on order_item_id. This table supports consolidated shipment tracking where sellers ship multiple order items together with unified tracking information.

foreignFields.name: shipment_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged shipment's {@link shopping_mall_shipments.id}.

models.name: shopping_mall_reviews
models.description: Customer reviews and ratings for purchased products with verified order item linkage. Each review represents authentic feedback from a customer who has purchased and received a specific product. Reviews are linked to order items to verify purchase authenticity and enforce one-review-per-order constraint. Supports soft deletion to preserve review history while hiding content from public view. Related to {@link shopping_mall_review_snapshots} which preserves immutable historical states of review edits.

foreignFields.name: shopping_order_item_id

models.name: shopping_mall_review_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable historical snapshots of review state changes.

Captures point-in-time states of reviews whenever they are edited or deleted, preserving the rating and content as they existed at that moment. These snapshots serve critical business purposes:

- **Audit trail**: Complete history of review modifications for transparency
- **Dispute resolution**: Evidence of review content at any point in time
- **Post-deletion access**: Reviews remain accessible through snapshots even after soft deletion
- **Historical display**: Shows what review looked like when order was evaluated

Each snapshot is created automatically before a review update or delete operation. Once created, snapshots are never modified or deleted, ensuring data integrity for compliance and dispute resolution scenarios.

Related to {@link shopping_mall_reviews} through shopping_mall_review_id foreign key. Multiple snapshots can exist for a single review, forming a chronological history.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_id
foreignFields.description: Parent review's {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}. Establishes which review this snapshot captures the state of.

foreignFields.name: snapshot_by_user_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id} who triggered this snapshot creation through edit or delete operation. Provides audit trail of who made the change.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Review rating at snapshot time. Integer value from 1 to 5 stars. Denormalized from parent review to preserve historical state.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Review text content at snapshot time. Optional detailed feedback from customer. Denormalized from parent review to preserve historical state, including null values if review had no content.

plainFields.name: snapshot_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created. Represents the exact moment the review state was captured, typically just before an update or delete operation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Database record creation timestamp. Automatically set when snapshot row is inserted.

plainIndexes.description: Composite index for efficiently retrieving snapshots of a specific review in chronological order.

models.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_requests
models.description:
Customer cancellation requests for order items with status workflow and seller response tracking.

Represents formal requests submitted by customers to cancel specific order items before or after shipment. Each request captures the cancellation reason, current status (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED), and tracks the seller's response when applicable.

Key relationships:
- {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}: The order item being cancelled (required, 1:N relationship)
- {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}: The customer who submitted the request (required)
- {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}: The seller who responded to the request (nullable, only for APPROVED/REJECTED status)

Behavioral notes:
- Status workflow: PENDING → APPROVED or REJECTED
- Only order items with PAID status can be cancelled (business rule)
- responded_at and responded_by_seller_id are null when status is PENDING
- Immutable history preserved in {@link shopping_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots}

foreignFields.name: order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Target order item's {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id} being cancelled.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Submitted customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: responded_by_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Responding seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}. Null when status is PENDING.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer's reason for requesting cancellation.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current cancellation status: PENDING, APPROVED, or REJECTED.

plainFields.name: requested_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer submitted the cancellation request.

plainFields.name: responded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller responded to the request. Null when status is PENDING.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null when record is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable snapshots of cancellation request states for audit trail and dispute resolution.

Captures point-in-time states whenever a cancellation request's status changes or is responded to by the seller. Each snapshot preserves the complete state including reason, status, and response details at the moment of capture. Snapshots are append-only and never modified or deleted, ensuring a complete historical record for dispute resolution and compliance auditing.

Related to {@link shopping_mall_cancellation_requests} as the parent entity. Multiple snapshots can exist for a single cancellation request, creating a chronological audit trail of all state changes.

foreignFields.name: responded_by_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who responded to the cancellation request's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}. Null if no response yet.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Cancellation request status at snapshot time. Valid values: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED.

plainFields.name: requested_at
plainFields.description: Original timestamp when the cancellation request was submitted by the customer.

plainFields.name: responded_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot record was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_requests
models.description:
Customer refund requests for order items with delivery date tracking for 7-day validation.

Represents refund requests submitted by customers for delivered order items. Each request tracks the reason for refund, current status (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED), and delivery date to validate the 7-day refund window. Sellers respond to requests by updating status and recording response timestamp.

Key relationships:
- Belongs to {@link shopping_mall_order_items} - the specific order item being refunded
- Submitted by {@link shopping_mall_customers} - the customer requesting refund
- Responded by {@link shopping_mall_sellers} - the seller who processes the request (nullable until responded)
- Has immutable snapshots in {@link shopping_mall_refund_request_snapshots} for audit trail

Business constraints:
- Refund requests only allowed within 7 days of delivery (validated by delivered_at)
- Status transitions: PENDING → APPROVED or PENDING → REJECTED
- One refund request per order item (enforced by unique index on order_item_id)

foreignFields.name: order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Order item's {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}. The specific order item being refunded.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id} who submitted the refund request.

foreignFields.name: responded_by_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id} who responded to the refund request. Null until seller responds.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer's reason for requesting refund. Explains why the customer wants a refund for this order item.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the refund request. Values: PENDING (awaiting seller response), APPROVED (seller approved refund), REJECTED (seller rejected refund).

plainFields.name: delivered_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order item was delivered. Used to validate the 7-day refund request window.

plainFields.name: requested_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer submitted the refund request.

plainFields.name: responded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller responded to the refund request. Null until seller responds.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refund request record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refund request record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refund request was soft deleted. Null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_request_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable snapshots of refund request states for audit trail and dispute resolution.

Captures point-in-time states of refund requests including all business fields and relationships at the moment of state change. These snapshots preserve the complete refund request context (order item, customer, seller response) whenever status transitions occur (submission, approval, rejection).

Referenced by {@link shopping_mall_refund_requests} for historical audit access. Used in dispute resolution to verify the timeline of refund request processing, validate 7-day delivery windows, and ensure compliance with platform refund policies. Append-only table - never updated or deleted.

plainFields.name: status
